description:
Blue Sky Property are delighted to bring to the market another exquisite example of Hollywood Homes Luxury Homes in the upmarket seaside village of Blackrock Co. Louth. Hillcrest House is a strikingly newly constructed detached home, positioned on Blackrock’s prestigious Rock Road. Designed for modern family life and finished to the highest contemporary standard, this 2,400 sq ft residence delivers a rare combination of elegance, comfort with seamless indoor-outdoor living in one of County Louth’s most desirable seaside villages, moments away from Blackrock promenade looking out on Dundalk Bay. 

Architecture & Design
From the moment you arrive at Hillcrest, this property makes a striking impression. With beautifully landscaped approach entered via bespoke electric gates, leading to a substantial façade with clean architectural lines, high-quality external finishes and secure off-street parking. The entrance opens into a bright, generously proportioned reception hall flooded with natural light, a theme that carries through every room of the house.

The interior has been crafted with modern family living in mind. An open-plan layout forms the heart of the home, where a stunning kitchen flows seamlessly into expansive living and dining areas both inside and out. Floor-to-ceiling glazing frames views of the rear garden and draws sunlight deep into the space, creating an effortless connection between indoors and out.


Kitchen & Living Spaces
The kitchen is a statement of contemporary elegance, hand-finished cabinetry, premium quartz worktops, a generous island with breakfast bar and a full suite of integrated appliances. Thoughtful touches with soft-close drawers, concealed storage and designer lighting, elevate the space to a level rarely seen in new-build homes.

Adjacent living areas offer flexibility and comfort. Whether hosting guests in the formal reception room, relaxing in the family lounge or dining with views of the landscaped garden, every space has been designed for both everyday ease and effortless entertaining.


Bedroom Accommodation
Upstairs, four generous double bedrooms provide exceptional family accommodation. Each bedroom benefits from an en-suite bathroom, finished to a luxurious standard with contemporary sanitaryware, quality tiling and thoughtful design details throughout.

The principal suite is a true retreat, with a spacious bedroom with a bespoke walk-in wardrobe and an indulgent en-suite bathroom featuring premium fixtures and a calming, spa-like aesthetic. 

The remaining bedrooms are equally well-appointed, each offering privacy, comfort, and flexible use as family rooms, guest accommodation or a home office.


Specification & Sustainability
Hillcrest is built to A-rated energy efficiency standards, combining sustainability with style. High-performance insulation, quality glazing, and modern heating systems ensure long-term comfort and significantly reduced running costs. Every element, from joinery and flooring to lighting and fixtures, all have been selected for durability, beauty, and ease of maintenance.


Gardens & Grounds
Externally, the property is equally impressive. A sun-drenched south-west-facing rear garden offers complete privacy and a wonderful sense of space, ideal for al fresco dining, children's play or simply unwinding with views of the surrounding landscape. Low-maintenance planting, quality paving, and thoughtful design ensure the garden is as practical as it is beautiful.


Location
Blackrock is one of County Louth's most desirable coastal villages, celebrated for its picturesque beach, vibrant promenade and welcoming community atmosphere. Charming cafés, restaurants, boutiques and essential amenities line the waterfront, while the village is served by excellent primary schools and sporting facilities—including Dundalk Golf Club and the nearby Fairways Hotel.


Dundalk Town Centre is only minutes away, and the M1 motorway provides swift access to both Dublin and Belfast, making this an ideal location for commuters and families alike.


Summary
Hillcrest, Rock Road, Blackrock, represents a rare opportunity to acquire a landmark new home in one of Ireland's most charming seaside communities with unrivalled coastal setting, this truly is modern luxury living at its very best. For all further inquiries contact Blue Sky Property on 042-9329333.
